messages:
maria: Heads up — draft for landing copy variants for the tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) is ready for review. Want to align messaging and decide CTA funnels (webinar signup vs. demo request).
ben: Nice. Can we tie Hosted to 'quick time-to-value' benchmark narrative and Dedicated to 'predictable throughput & SLA'? Private -> 'security & control'?
liam: Agree. Also need clear lead routing: Hosted -> self-serve signup, Dedicated -> sales demo, Private -> enterprise contact + compliance packet. @hubspot-bot can we set up hidden UTM for each?
hubspot-bot: Sure. I created three forms: hosted_lead, dedicated_demo, private_contact. webhook -> #inbound-routing. Sample UTMs: ?utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_source=website&utm_content=hosted
emma: For hero CTAs, propose: Hosted: 'Start in minutes — Try Hosted', Dedicated: 'Reserve dedicated capacity', Private: 'Contact sales for private deployment' — A/B test with 'Get started' on all.
sam: We should also surface benchmark snippet under Hosted: '200ms avg latency for 768-token prompts in our hosted tier' — but need sign-off from eng-ml.
maria: I'll ping @liam and @sam to confirm numbers. Also planning a webinar (Apr 12) to drive mid-funnel leads. Should we link webinar CTA on Hosted and Dedicated pages?
liam: Yes for Dedicated. Hosted probably too low-friction; maybe add 'Join webinar' in footer/secondary CTA.
ada-design: Got it — I'll create a variant with primary vs secondary CTAs and a narrow hero for mobile. Sharing Figma after lunch: https://figma.com/file/tri-mode-landing
ben: Copy tweak suggestion: Hosted headline: 'Launch LLM features fast' -> 'Ship LLM features fast — hosted inference that scales'
emma: Benchmarks page needs a filter: Show workloads (chat / generation / embeddings). Also add a small 'how we measured' modal for transparency.
maria: Decision points: (1) CTA routing mapping (2) Hero copy variants (3) Benchmark snippets + modal (4) Webinar integration + lead flow. Any blockers?
sam: Need legal review for benchmark claims. I'll open a ticket and tag @legal.
liam: I'll drop a quick yaml for routing rules for ops:
```yaml
routes:
  /hosted:
    cta_primary: hosted_signup_form
    cta_secondary: webinar_signup_form
  /dedicated:
    cta_primary: dedicated_demo_form
    cta_secondary: webinar_signup_form
  /private:
    cta_primary: private_contact_form
    cta_secondary: sales_whitepaper
```
hubspot-bot: Routing rules saved to /marketing/landing-routing.yaml and webhook configured to #inbound-routing.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll run a 1-week copy sprint. Target: deploy variants behind feature flag, measure CR and demo requests. Who can help QA the forms?
ben: Emma + me can QA this afternoon.
ada-design: I'll upload mobile / compressed assets and annotate components in Figma.
maria: Perfect. I'll update the launch plan doc, add webinar promo post cadence, and set tracking for UTMs. Thanks team!
